verses.english: “Someone with three qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there. …

verses.pali: visamena kāyakammena, visamena vacīkammena, visamena manokammena—
verses.english: Unethical deeds by way of body, speech, and mind. …
Someone with three qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there. …

verses.pali: samena kāyakammena, samena vacīkammena, samena manokammena—
verses.english: Ethical deeds by way of body, speech, and mind. …”
